note: Two separate sites on grass clearings on the east side of Eleven Mile Road, about 550 m apart: 012 Landing A about 0.9 mile south of Little Moores Run Road and 013 Landing B, a retired log landing, about 1.3 miles south of it (4.7 and 4.4 miles north of Southwoods Road). The agency cautions that it is reached by dirt or gravel forest roads that may not suit low-clearance vehicles or large RVs. Stone fire rings; no table, toilet or water. Pack out trash. --Claude
